title: EEG neurofeedback 'chair' sessions targeting theta and gamma
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: on the chair, right? I I I call it the chair, but this was where a lot of my traumatic memories actually like came back in that earlier 22.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, who tells Michels he was taken into a UFO programme as a child, says that between 2008 and 2010 at Baker Victory Services in Western New York he went through sessions of EEG neurofeedback, where his brain waves were recorded and fed back to him to train particular rhythms, here the slow theta and fast gamma waves. He calls the setup 'the chair' and says it was 'where a lot of my traumatic memories actually like came back', which, if true, would mean children's minds were being deliberately trained in such a programme.
